This dataset records capacity-normalised photovoltaic (PV) power generation from residential and commercial solar plants across the United Kingdom, sampled on a dense 30-minute grid. Values lie in [0, 1], where 0 is night or an outage and 1 is the plant's rated capacity. The series is strongly seasonal with a 48-step daily cycle whose amplitude and daylight window drift over the year, and is modulated at shorter scales by cloud cover. The task is to forecast the next 6 hours (12 steps) of output from a 14-day history, to assist grid management and renewable energy optimization.
